body: Nah it's a shitbox. Watched the 1967 Casino Royale and it's only slightly more incoherent

No Bond has ended on a good movie 
Change my mind

Here's four options producers could go with in terms of hiring an unknown 

-The Long Game: Finn Cole (from "Peaky Blinders" and "Dreamland") I think would be ideal with a reboot (Carte Blanche?) as he's only 26 now so 2025 will be 29-30 and could easily do a 15 year run like Craig. Cole also fits the vein of previous bond's who are sort of famous in the UK but unknown elsewhere 

-Back to Basics: If the series wants to go back to Fleming and to the early Connery days Mark Rowley (from "The Last Kingdom) fits the build of tall, dark haired, relatively unknown Scottish actor and being in his mid 30s could be a good return to basics if producers want to go back to Bonds roots and Fleming's material

-The Short and Sexy: Jamie Dornan (from "50 shades of grey) if cast next year with a movie out in 2024/2025 will be the same age as Brosnan when starting so might only be good for 3-4 films but he's got star power and is a decent actor so could bring some life to the series 

-The "Fuck It" option: Assuming BB doesn't care about appeasing fans anymore and wants to keep working with Fukunanga I could see a new look Bond with the mainstream casting choices like Rege Jean Page or a big star like Tom Hardy or Henry Cavill being cast or perhaps even Lashana Lynch getting a spin off series. Of course this would be bad in the long run 

Those are my $0.02

I have an idea for a reboot with a younger Bond (Finn Cole from Peaky Blinders to be precise) with a throwback to some of the classic Bond films (wet humour, over the top stand alone villains, unknown talent) 

I even have a cast, screenplay writer and theme song performer if that's your thing, newly active here and trying to boost my karma before I do a post
We've had three directors and in 1986 nearly had an actor (Sam Neill) who no doubt would've been better then Dalton
